name: Teisha Parking
description: Teisha Parking: a landing-page theme for a commercial car-park operator that leases monthly bays. The home page opens on a pale wash with one inset window of three equal low-key dusk photographs divided by hairlines that run past the frame like bay markings, a stepped three-line catch, an italic caption crossing the window edge and one outline pill. A slow hairline ticker of site names and a ledger of thin numerals follow, then asymmetric site masonry, a parallax dusk band, four ruled steps, the contract coverage, a plain fee table, drivers' notes and a single navy request band. Figtree for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.
